_readme: Copy to feeds.json (gitignored) and fill in real people. Keys under 'people' must match the person's People-note filename (without .md). Only free/busy is ever cached; event titles are discarded at parse time.

[Friend Name].note: optional freeform: which calendar this is, when they shared it

[Friend With Apple Calendar].note: webcal:// URLs are rewritten to https:// automatically
